source: design §5.7 E1, §2.2 rows, §2.3 collision table, §6.1 legacy ids

fields.prompt: a string, or for a collision row [EN, PT-BR]; every prompt must land on `expected` through a row listed in `decidedBy`

fields.collision: true for a §2.3 row; build renders the §2.3 table from these entries in id order (says, about, expected, decidedBy, decidedByNote)
fields.seed: true for a §5.7 seed case that broke revision 1
